preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically minimum coloring of the table.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in table)
postconditions.description: Each row in the table must have exactly m columns.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in row) for row in table)
postconditions.description: All characters in the table must be uppercase Latin letters.
